answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware enclave attestation. Rather than trusting identities from an ivory tower of pure software, each agent must anchor its execution thread to a physical security chip. Admitting nodes onto this mesa of certified hardware forces an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of purchasing physical enclaves per identity. However, this design centralizes trust in hardware vendor supply chains and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
